description.value:
Cast 1 minute

Range 60 feet

You can tell, across a room, which one of them has done this before.

Study a group of creatures you can see. You learn which of them has killed, which of them is armed in a way they are hiding, and which one the others will look to first when it starts. You do not learn names, intentions, or numbers — only the shape of who in the room is dangerous, which is usually the part that matters.
